description: This file defines the ConnectionBuilder interface, which provides a fluent API for constructing Connection objects with various configurable properties such as ID, name, credentials, URI, status, and other connection-related settings.

classes.name: ConnectionBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder interface for constructing Connection objects with a fluent API, allowing configuration of connection parameters such as ID, name, credentials, URI, status, and more.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Sets the identifier to use in the Connection.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Sets the name to use in the Connection.

methods.name: credentials
methods.description: Sets the connection credentials.

methods.name: credentialsFromJson
methods.description: Sets the connection credentials from a JSON object.

methods.name: trustedCertificates
methods.description: Sets the trusted certificates for the connection.

methods.name: uri
methods.description: Sets the URI to use in the Connection.

methods.name: connectionStatus
methods.description: Sets the ConnectionStatus.

methods.name: failoverEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables fail-over for the connection.

methods.name: validateCertificate
methods.description: Enables or disables certificate validation.

methods.name: processorPoolSize
methods.description: Sets the command processor pool size.

methods.name: sources
methods.description: Adds sources to the connection.

methods.name: targets
methods.description: Adds targets to the connection.

methods.name: setSources
methods.description: Sets the sources of the connection.

methods.name: setTargets
methods.description: Sets the targets of the connection.

methods.name: clientCount
methods.description: Sets how many clients should establish the connection for HA mode.

methods.name: specificConfig
methods.description: Adds specific configuration for the connection type.

methods.name: mappingContext
methods.description: Sets the mapping context for message transformation.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Sets multiple tags for the connection.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a single tag to the connection.

methods.name: lifecycle
methods.description: Sets the connection lifecycle.

methods.name: payloadMappingDefinition
methods.description: Sets the payload mapping definition.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new Connection instance with the configured parameters.
